title: EMode Photonix Raises $1M Pre-Seed Round Led by Ground State Ventures for Photonic Circuit Simulation Stack - Quantum Computing Report
gist: EMode Photonix, a Boulder startup, raised a $1M pre-seed led by Ground State Ventures for its multi-physics simulation platform for non-linear integrated photonic circuits, claiming up to 1,000x speedup, its first institutional capital after SBIR grants and software revenue.

insights.claim: EMode Photonix closed a $1 million pre-seed round led by Ground State Ventures with Harlow Capital Management participating, its first institutional capital after years of SBIR awards from NASA, NSF and NIST and commercial software revenue.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Small seed signal for the quantum photonics tooling layer.

insights.claim: The funds will expand the Boulder engineering team and accelerate an enterprise software offering aimed at automating photonic IC design within a single day for quantum computing, optical sensing and telecom.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem

insights.claim: EMode's platform models non-linear integrated photonic circuits with coupled thermal, RF and non-linear optical dynamics and claims up to 1,000x speedup over traditional non-linear photonics modeling workflows.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Vendor-claimed; faster simulation could shorten quantum photonic hardware design cycles.

insights.claim: EMode was co-founded in 2021 by CEO Eric Stanton and Maiya A. S. and is supported by industry veterans including Chad Rigetti, Kris Kaczmarek, Colby Harlow, Nic Weiroster, Martin SFP Bryant and Ton van 't Noordende.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
